_about: Readings of the remake photo refs/dq3/remake/r_20261030_050039_pond_peninsula.png (pond and peninsula, the pair of Aurhea's Fountain). NUMBERS ONLY: no image, no crop of the photo is stored anywhere. Measured by script on luminance and colour thresholds and by eye on an 8x enlargement; the photo is a PICTURE OF A SCREEN (blurred, tilted, cropped on the right), so every number has a tolerance. Panel = the game area of the photo (rows 50-319, columns 7-461, 270 rows). The hero is the leader of the party (the head of the column, the farthest one).

gameArea.note: cropped on the right: DQ3 is 16:9 (480 x 270 would be the full width), so fractions of the width use fx 0.50 [R]

heroPx.how: leader: head top at row ~190, robe ends at row ~227, feet hidden by the next character (0 to +3 px); 8x enlargement

fx.how: leader centre at column 245.6: (245.6 - 7) / 454 = 0.526 of the cropped width, 0.497 of a 480 px (16:9) width; 0.50 taken [R]

fy.how: centre of the leader (head 190 to feet ~229): row ~210; (210 - 50) / 270. Head 0.52, feet ~0.66

M5b.how: width of the peninsula in H at the leader's feet row (228): water edges at columns 175 and 306 = 131 px; / 36.5 px of hero height. 3.0 H at the middle of the hero, 3.9 H at row 240

M8b.how: far edge of the water (first water row at the hero's column = row 128) above the hero's head (row 190): (190 - 128) / 36.5. The rock border of the far shore is at row ~112: 2.2 H (head) / 3.2 H (feet)

M1.how: by eye: water, the mound, the far bank; one walkable level in the frame

M3a.how: grass up to the top of the frame, no sky and no void

M4.how: N/A: no landmark in the photo; the goal of the place is where the party stands

lakeW.how: widest contiguous run of blue water along a row, in hero heights (36.5 px): rows 176-206 run from the left edge of the game area (col 7) to the right edge of the photo (col 461) = 455 px = 12.5 H (it touches the cropped edge, so it is a LOWER BOUND); rows 150-158, with the right shore inside the frame, 405 px = 11.1 H. Mask: blue / cyan (b > r + 45, b >= g - 5, b > 90), opened 3 x 3, closed 41 px along the rows (padded) so the sparkles and the white reflection count as water; value 12.0 +- 0.5
